# Phil Romeril

Phil Romeril has participated in 1 election since 2002:

- [**2022 Deputies Election**](https://flow.je/elections/candidates/phil-romeril#e48)

  Not elected.

  - [2022 Vote.je Manifesto](https://www.vote.je/candidates/2022/phil-romeril/)
  - [2022 Vote.je Video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=H3QB_9UcNKA)

Phil Romeril has declared his intention to stand in the upcoming [2026 Deputies Election](https://flow.je/elections/2026) in [District 3](https://flow.je/elections/district-3). \[[jerseyeveningpost.com](https://jerseyeveningpost.com/news/2026/03/25/value-jersey-founding-member-to-stand-for-deputy/)\]

Links for Phil Romeril:

- Twitter : [@laprom](https://twitter.com/laprom)
